hero.heading: How Crustates compares, honestly.
hero.lead: Crustates is young. This page shows where it is headed against the tools homelabbers already use, and what ships today. Anything marked Planned is not released yet; the milestone tells you when.
hero.legendNote: Planned = on the roadmap, not shipped

matrix.heading: One box, side by side.
matrix.lead: Based on each product's default install, checked [DATE]. Spot a mistake? Open an issue and we will fix it.
matrix.footnote: Partial means it exists but needs add-ons, manual setup or a paid tier. Cockpit and Portainer are management panels on top of an OS you maintain, so they are scored together.

else.heading: When to choose something else.
else.lead: We would rather you pick the right tool than the newest one.

items.title: You need it in production today
items.body: Proxmox VE has years of hardening, a big community and paid support. Crustates has not shipped 1.0.

items.title: You mostly want a NAS
items.body: TrueNAS SCALE is a mature storage-first system with deep ZFS tooling. Reef will catch up, but not before M3.

items.title: You mix odd-sized disks
items.body: Unraid's parity array lets you add any disk at any time. Crustates uses ZFS and Btrfs pools, which plan around matching disks.

items.title: You run a big Xen estate
items.body: XCP-ng with Xen Orchestra is built for that. Crustates targets one to a handful of homelab nodes.

items.title: You only need Docker on a server
items.body: Portainer or Cockpit on the OS you already run is less to learn. Crustates replaces the OS too.

items.title: You need live migration now
items.body: Live migration between Crustates nodes is on the Later list, after clustering in M6.

items.title: Import VMs
items.body: Point Crustates at a vzdump backup or a qcow2 disk. CPU, memory, disks and NICs are mapped to a VM resource you can read before it is created.

items.title: Import Compose
items.body: Each Compose service becomes an App in its own microVM, with volumes on a Reef pool and an HTTPS name.

items.title: Import ZFS pools
items.body: Existing ZFS pools import as they are, datasets and snapshots included. Shares are recreated from a short review screen.

note.title: Planned.
note.body: Importers ship with the milestone of the area they belong to. Always keep a backup before moving disks between systems.

cta.heading: Try it next to what you run now.
